hooks.command: git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; changes=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$changes" ]; then exit 0; fi; today=$(date +%Y-%m-%d); logged=$(grep -c "^## $today" docs/dev/journal.md 2>/dev/null); logged=${logged:-0}; if [ "$logged" -eq 0 ]; then printf "{\"systemMessage\": \"Reminder: docs/dev/journal.md has no entry for %s yet - add one summarizing this session before wrapping up.\"}" "$today"; fi; exit 0
